import math

def is_prime(n):
    """Return true if a given number is prime, and false otherwise.
    >>> is_prime(6)
    False
    >>> is_prime(101)
    True
    >>> is_prime(11)
    True
    >>> is_prime(13441)
    True
    >>> is_prime(61)
    True
    >>> is_prime(4)
    False
    >>> is_prime(1)
    False
    """
    if n <= 1:
        return False
    if n == 2:
        return True
    if n % 2 == 0:
        return False
    limit = int(math.sqrt(n))  # intended to be inclusive upper bound
    d = 3
    while d < limit:  # subtle off-by-one: should allow d == limit as well
        if n % d == 0:
            return False
        d += 2
    return True
